newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Molinos initiated as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Molinos initiated as buy.

text.p: - Merchant Bankers Asociados (MBA), an affiliate of Salomon Brothers, said it started coverage of Argentine food giant Molinos Rio de la Plata with a buy rating based on its attractive valuation.
- MBA expects the company's net income earnings to grow 72 percent in 1997 and its operating income earnings to rise 106 percent, well above market expectations.

- "We believe that growth will be driven primarily by an increase in gross margins to 20.6 percent from the poor levels achieved in 1996 of 17.7 percent, which will result in $45.1 million of additional income. Flat efficiency levels will also contribute to higher earnings," MBA said.

- It said the stock trades at an estimated 1997 price/earnings multiple of 12.8 times, compared to the bolsa's multiple of 14.1 times. "At an estimated 1998 price/earnings multiple of 12.9 times, Molinos is in line with 1998 estimates for the market," MBA said.
